t: DEWALT 24" box beam level (600mm) with large cross-section provides excellent durability, ideal for professionals and DIY enthusiasts handling demanding tasks such as cabinet installation or general building work. The robust and accurate measuring tool with aluminium box section frame features solid block vials with an accuracy of +/-0.5mm, and includes 2 x 90° and 1 x 180° vials, and a magnified and bridged centre vial for versatile levelling. The non-magnetic base simplifies use on various surfaces, while hang holes on both ends allow for convenient storage and transportation on site.
